title: Module Enablement and Status
description: Modules registered on the platform, their status in this workspace and access to their settings.
manageHint: Only workspace owners and administrators can enable or disable modules.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.text: You do not have permission to access this area.

maintenance.title: Module under maintenance
maintenance.text: This module's operations are temporarily suspended.

not_enabled.title: Module disabled
not_enabled.text: This module is not enabled in this workspace.

not_contracted.title: Module not contracted
not_contracted.text: Your company's plan does not include this module. Talk to whoever manages your plan.

suspended.title: Subscription suspended
suspended.text: This module is read-only while the subscription is suspended.

unavailable.title: Module Unavailable
unavailable.text: This module is not available at this stage of the platform.
